name: Unsupported .NET Framework target framework
description: Flags projects that target unsupported .NET Framework target framework monikers so modernization work can start from a deterministic lifecycle risk.
impact: Unsupported target frameworks increase operational, security, and modernization risk.
evidenceRequirements: Project target framework metadata must be available from extracted project facts.
recommendedActions: Plan migration to a supported .NET target framework and review dependencies that constrain the target framework.
